script_text: Taurus, the cosmos just lit a fire under your love life and your career — and you won't see this coming. Early this week, your ruling Venus in your 5th House sextiles Jupiter, sparking romantic chemistry and creative confidence on Monday and Tuesday, but Wednesday sharpens when Mercury squares Saturn in your 10th House — career plans hit a wall, miscommunications at work could cost you. The turning point arrives Thursday as the Sun conjuncts your 5th House, igniting passion and clarity in relationships. By Friday through Sunday, Venus trines your 10th House — your professional image shines, and a financial opportunity tied to your creative talents emerges. Wednesday is your worst day because Mercury squares Saturn demanding patience with authority figures, while Saturday is your power day because Venus trines your 10th House bringing recognition and money flow. Guard your heavy earth energy this week by writing down every creative idea before Thursday. Follow me for daily updates.
